views.title: Datadex

summary: Datadex is a static landing page for a serverless, local-first open data platform. Its whole UI is one page: logo, tagline, three link buttons, an intro paragraph, a Principles definition list, a footer and a theme toggle. I saved that page in its default theme as one view ("landing", reached straight from /). The buttons all go to outside sites (Hugging Face and GitHub), and the theme toggle only changes the look, so there were no other screens to capture.
